description:
Blockchain Fees Tezos: fee recommendations and fee estimation for XTZ, FA1.2, and FA2 transfers.

Actions:
• get-fee-recommendations: Get current minimal fee/cost rates from the mempool
• estimate-transfer: Estimate the fee for a native XTZ transfer
• estimate-fa12-transfer: Estimate the fee for an FA1.2 token transfer
• estimate-fa2-transfer: Estimate the fee for an FA2 token transfer

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• estimate-fa12-transfer: 52
• estimate-fa2-transfer: 52
• estimate-transfer: 52
• get-fee-recommendations: 52

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

amount.description: Amount in mutez (transfer) or token base units (fa12/fa2) as an integer string - required for all estimate actions

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

contractAddress.description: FA1.2/FA2 token contract address - required for estimate-fa12-transfer, estimate-fa2-transfer

recipient.description: Recipient address - required for estimate-transfer, estimate-fa12-transfer, estimate-fa2-transfer

sender.description: Sender address - required for estimate-transfer, estimate-fa12-transfer, estimate-fa2-transfer

senderPublicKey.description: Sender's public key - required only when the source account is unrevealed (all estimate actions)

tokenId.description: FA2 token ID as an integer STRING (e.g. "0") - estimate-fa2-transfer only; the API rejects a number

name: blockchain_fees__blockchain_fees_tezos
